# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image comparison tools**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159 will introduce an experimental package for comparing rendered images and diagnosing differences. SkiaSharp.Testing will provide configurable image comparisons and visual diagnostics. This release will also stop including Linux x86 native assets; affected deployments must move to a supported architecture.

## Breaking Changes

- **Migrate Linux x86 deployments before upgrading** — NuGet packages will no longer include Linux x86 native assets, following upstream .NET's removal of Linux x86 cross-build infrastructure. Move 32-bit x86 Linux deployments to a supported architecture before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Configurable image comparisons** — The new SkiaSharp.Testing package adds SKImageComparison for SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and MAE, RMS and PSNR metrics. Its APIs are experimental: opt in by suppressing diagnostic SKIA4001 through NoWarn or a pragma. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))
- **Visual difference diagnostics** — Generate binary masks, channel differences, threshold maps, overlays and heatmaps using the same tolerance and masking rules as comparison. Returned difference images are independent, caller-owned SKImage instances that callers must dispose; comparison results retain no native handles. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))
